integrity_notes: An analytic proof establishes every dimension. Standalone exact rational and direct-enumeration checks are supplementary and do not amount to independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only unions of two complete Boolean Hamming shells; uniform per-point weights, constant-plus-degree-one Walsh band.
No claim of globally minimal sample cardinality or classification under optional per-shell reweighting.
The cubic statement assumes dimension at least three.
Complete worldwide originality cannot be guaranteed from indexed and accessible literature.
title: Square-law classification for unweighted two-shell Walsh sampling
